primary_contract: nwau_py.ar_drg_grouper local external grouper reference and precomputed AR-DRG provenance interface
description: Define a safe AR-DRG grouper integration track for admitted acute workflows that can ingest precomputed DRGs or call a user-supplied licensed external grouper without claiming proprietary grouper support.
completion_policy: complete-with-gaps means the repository owns metadata-only AR-DRG grouper integration contracts, precomputed AR-DRG provenance records, local-only external reference declarations, and fail-closed compatibility checks; it does not bundle, reimplement, validate, or claim proprietary AR-DRG grouping logic.

implemented: fail-closed diagnostics for unsupported or missing licensed groupers
not_implemented: automatic ICD-to-AR-DRG calculation without a licensed local provider
support_scope.claim_boundary: Local external-grouper reference and precomputed AR-DRG provenance interface; proprietary grouper support remains unclaimed.

gap_register.summary: Licensed external grouper parity remains deferred to local licensed product workflow and parity fixture tracks.
The repository does not reimplement or redistribute proprietary AR-DRG grouping logic, licensed classification tables, or official vendor tooling.
